name: Sandbagger Supreme
flavorText: You will call yourself weak while casually flashing something everyone else has been projecting for weeks. Whether this is modesty or a long con is genuinely unclear, even to you.
favouriteHold: Whatever happens to be on the wall
villainLine: They'll analyze exactly why your "warm-up" send worked. You'd really rather they didn't.
partnerLine: They bring the rest days, you bring the surprise sends — a suspiciously effective, low-key duo.
